blurb: Marina Park overlooks Dillon Reservoir and is surrounded by the Ten Mile and Gore Ranges. It offers lakeshore access, picnic tables with shades, a large updated playground, fishing opportunities, charcoal grills, and access to the Summit County Recreation Path around the lake. The Marina Park Pavilion is available for reservation and the park is open from sunrise until one hour after sunset for day use only.
extraNote: All parks are for day use only and may be used on a first come first use basis · Marina Park, Dillon Reservoir area
